title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease and hypertension.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of chronic kidney disease and hypertension. He reports feeling well overall and denies any recent episodes of edema, shortness of breath, or significant fatigue. He is adherent to his current medication regimen and reports stable blood pressure readings at home. He is here today for a laboratory review and blood pressure monitoring.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable. Blood pressure is 132/82 mmHg. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema is noted in the lower extremities.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 2.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medications as prescribed. Order a repeat BMP and serum creatinine to monitor renal function. Follow up in three months for a repeat laboratory review and blood pressure check.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
